package clientmembers_test

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	client "example.com/clientmembers/gen/http/members/client"
	service "example.com/clientmembers/gen/members"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
	loom "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/pkg"
)

type audit struct {
	methods []string
}

func TestServiceClientRoles(t *testing.T) {
	peer := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if r.Header.Get("Accept") == "text/event-stream" {
			if r.URL.Path != "/watch" {
				t.Errorf("stream path %q", r.URL.Path)
			}
			w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")
			if _, err := fmt.Fprint(w, "data: \"stream\"\n\n"); err != nil {
				t.Error(err)
			}
			return
		}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		if _, err := fmt.Fprintf(w, "%q", r.URL.Path); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	}))
	defer peer.Close()
	u, err := url.Parse(peer.URL)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	transport := client.NewClient(u.Scheme, u.Host, peer.Client(), loomhttp.RequestEncoder, loomhttp.ResponseDecoder, false)
	interceptor := &audit{}
	c := service.NewClient(transport.Watch(), transport.WatchStreamStream(), transport.WatchStream(), transport.WatchStreamEndpoint(), interceptor)
	ctx := context.Background()
	ordinary, err := c.Watch(ctx, "payload")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "/watch", ordinary)
	stream, err := c.WatchStreamStream(ctx, "payload")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	value, err := stream.Recv()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "stream", value)
	require.NoError(t, stream.Close())
	authored, err := c.WatchStream(ctx, "payload")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "/watchStream", authored)
	fieldCompetitor, err := c.WatchStreamEndpoint(ctx, "payload")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "/watchStreamEndpoint", fieldCompetitor)
	require.Equal(t, []string{"Watch", "Watch", "WatchStream", "WatchStreamEndpoint"}, interceptor.methods)

	sentinel := errors.New("endpoint failure")
	failed := func(context.Context, any) (any, error) {
		return nil, sentinel
	}
	c = service.NewClient(failed, failed, failed, failed, nil)
	_, err = c.Watch(ctx, "payload")
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, sentinel)
	_, err = c.WatchStreamStream(ctx, "payload")
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, sentinel)
	_, err = c.WatchStream(ctx, "payload")
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, sentinel)
}

func (a *audit) Audit(ctx context.Context, info *service.AuditInfo, next loom.Endpoint) (any, error) {
	a.methods = append(a.methods, info.Method())
	return next(ctx, info.RawPayload())
}
